title: On the Risks of using LLM-Generated Tests for Regression Testing
title_zh: 使用大型语言模型生成的测试进行回归测试的风险

paragraphs.en: Software is under constant evolution. Developers continuously add features, fix bugs, and refactor code, and any of these changes may inadvertently break existing functionality. Regression testing guards against such unintended effects by capturing expected behavior in test cases: when a test fails after a change, it signals that previously established behavior has been altered. LLM-based test generation aims to automate this process by generating regression tests directly from the code under test. While this approach can be beneficial when the implementation is correct, it becomes particularly problematic when the code contains faults. In such cases, generated tests may encode and preserve incorrect behavior, allowing faults to persist and potentially influence subsequent stages of software evolution. To investigate this risk, we apply LLM-based regression test generation to pull requests merged into the main branch of software projects and study the impact of the generated tests on subsequent project evolution. We distinguish between fault-revealing , which assert correctly implemented behavior, and fault-enforcing tests , which assert faulty behavior. We then empirically quantify the extent to which fault-enforcing tests can preserve bugs and hinder their correction during software evolution. Across 145 pull requests from SciPy, Qiskit, and pandas, 8%–17% of the generated tests are fault-enforcing, while only 2.4%–4.8% reveal faults. Most of the remaining tests do not provide any relevant signal, i.e., they pass on both versions or fail on both. Fault-enforcing tests persist over time: after several subsequent commits, 83%–91% of them are still relevant and pass. We also find that fault-enforcing tests may also accumulate over time: when the faults of all pull requests are combined in one codebase, 83%–92% remain enforced at the end of the commit history, and the developer-written test suite detects only 14%–30% of them. Taken together, our results reveal a fundamental risk of LLM-generated regression tests: without manual validation, they may encode faulty behavior as expected behavior, allowing bugs to persist across software revisions and largely evade detection by developer-maintained test suites. As a result, LLM-based regression testing can give rise to a new form of technical debt, in which accumulated fault-enforcing tests perpetuate defects and constrain software evolution.

paragraphs.en: Modern software systems evolve continuously, with developers frequently submitting pull requests (PRs) that add features or fix bugs. Each change risks introducing a regression : functionality that worked before breaks after the change. Regression testing ( Yoo and Harman, 2012 ) detects such regressions, so that developers can react and fix the broken behavior if necessary. However, writing high-quality regression tests is among the most expensive activities in software maintenance ( Leung and White, 1989 ; Yoo and Harman, 2012 ) and requires substantial effort and domain knowledge. As a result, newly introduced behavior is often under-tested, leaving the project vulnerable to future regressions.

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in LLMs promise to reduce this effort. By exploiting code context, commit messages, and code diffs, LLM-based approaches can automatically generate executable regression tests for software changes. ChaCo ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) augments tests at the pull-request level by targeting previously uncovered lines; Liu et al. ( Liu et al., 2026 ) evaluate LLM-generated regression tests for commits; SymPrompt ( Ryan et al., 2024 ) uses code-aware prompting for coverage-guided generation; and CoverUp ( Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ) iteratively extends test suites using coverage feedback. These approaches report substantial coverage improvements with little manual intervention, which suggests that LLMs could considerably reduce the effort of maintaining evolving test suites.

paragraphs.en: Despite these efforts, LLM-generated regression tests differ fundamentally from a developer’s testing process. When a developer writes a regression test for a new PR and the test fails, they investigate whether the fault lies in the code or in the test ( Luo et al., 2014 ; Vahabzadeh et al., 2015 ) . LLM-based test generators instead treat the code as correct: they repair or discard failing tests ( Pizzorno and Berger, 2025 ; Gu et al., 2026 ) , so a bug in the PR is not surfaced. This difference relates to the oracle problem ( Barr et al., 2014 ) . When the implementation is the main available description of behavior, LLMs may infer assertions from what the current code does, rather than what it is intended to do ( Konstantinou et al., 2024 ) . When the code is defective, a generated test can thus encode the defect as expected behavior: the buggy implementation passes it, while a corrected version fails. We call such tests fault-enforcing (Figure 1 ).

paragraphs.en: Fault-enforcing tests become particularly risky in evolving projects: They appear harmless at creation because all tests passes, so the developer gets no signal that anything is wrong, and the test enters the suite as if it were a validated expectation. Its cost appears later. When the fault is eventually found and fixed, the test fails on the correct code, and the developer has to decide whether the failure is a regression or a wrong test, which can require examining recent changes to both the production and the test code ( Vahabzadeh et al., 2015 ) . Until then, the test makes the faulty behavior look specified: it adds coverage and test count without verifying intended behavior. In an evolving project that merges generated tests across many PRs, such tests can accumulate, each making an existing fault harder to fix and the suite less trustworthy over time.

paragraphs.en: Do LLM-generated regression tests enforce faults that persist and accumulate as the project evolves?
paragraphs.zh: 由大型语言模型生成的回归测试，是否会导致故障在项目演进过程中持续存在并累积？

paragraphs.en: We study this question on three open-source GitHub projects, SciPy, Qiskit, and pandas. We inject faults into historical PRs and generate regression tests for each of them, simulating a developer who accepts the generated tests without validating them. Such behavior is common in a vibe-coding setting ( Fawzy et al., 2026 ) where developers trust whatever the LLM produces. We then track whether the enforced faults persist through later project changes, accumulate across PRs, and escape detection by the project’s test suite.

paragraphs.en: Across 145 PRs (and 60,780 injected faults; Figure 2 ), we find that LLM-generated regression tests enforce faults consistently more often than they reveal them. Depending on the project, 8%–17% of the generated tests enforce the injected fault, while only 2.4%–4.8% reveal it. Enforced faults are also durable: after several later commits, 83%–91% of fault-enforcing tests still pass only on the faulty code, so fixing the fault would still break them. They accumulate as well: when the faults of all PRs are combined in one codebase, 83%–92% remain enforced by a generated test at the end of the commit history, and the project’s test suite detects only 14%–30% of them. Without manual validation, generated regression tests can therefore lock faults into the test suite.

paragraphs.en: A behavioral taxonomy of LLM-generated regression tests with four categories (fault-revealing, fault-enforcing, weak, invalid), which classifies each test by its behavior on the faulty and the fixed code and thus measures test quality beyond coverage, together with a mutation-based methodology that measures it by injecting faults into historical PRs and tracking the generated tests through the commit history.

paragraphs.en: Automated test generation has traditionally targeted the generation of regression tests at unit- or class-level with EvoSuite ( Fraser and Arcuri, 2011 ) and Pynguin ( Lukasczyk and Fraser, 2022 ) as popular examples. With recent advances in LLMs and the focus on more change-driven development, recent systems have started to focus more on generating tests at change-level, targeting lines modified in a commit or pull request. ChaCo ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) generates pull-request-aware tests that cover uncovered lines in merged patches; Liu et al. ( Liu et al., 2026 ) show that LLMs can produce commit-level tests that reproduce bug-introducing changes; Harman et al. ( Harman et al., 2025 ) generate mutants for specific code-level issues at Meta and have an LLM write tests that kill them, evaluated by the mutants killed and by engineer acceptance; and Haratian et al. ( Haratian et al., 2026 ) find that pull-request-aware generation, by an LLM or by EvoSuite, rarely yields tests that capture the change.

paragraphs.en: Change-aware mutation testing restricts mutation to code affected by recent changes. MuDelta ( Ma et al., 2021 ) introduces commit-relevant mutants, which correlate more strongly with real bugs than uniformly sampled ones; commit-aware mutation testing ( Ma et al., 2020 ) and studies across revisions ( Ojdanić et al., 2023 ; Ojdanić et al., 2022 ; Ojdanić, 2022 ) report gains in efficiency and effectiveness. Recent work combines mutation with LLMs: µBERT ( Degiovanni and Papadakis, 2022 ) generates realistic mutants with a pre-trained language model, Straubinger et al. ( Straubinger et al., 2025 ) use LLMs in a scientific-debugging loop to improve tests and mutation scores, and AdverTest ( Chang et al., 2026 ) pits a test-writing agent against a mutant-writing agent to strengthen tests for a program assumed correct. Closest to our work, Haroon et al. ( Haroon et al., 2026 ) evaluate LLM-based test generation on 22,374 program variants and find that many generated tests remain aligned with the original behavior under semantic-altering changes. Their changes are small mutations of seed programs, and tests are generated per variant, whereas we track generated tests through real PR history. We use commit-aware mutants ( Ma et al., 2021 ; Ma et al., 2020 ) as injected faults, a proxy for real bugs, and study the persistence and accumulation of fault-enforcing tests across PR history, which, to our knowledge, prior work has not studied.

paragraphs.en: The effectiveness of a test depends on the correctness of its oracle. While generating executable test inputs has become increasingly practical, generating assertions that capture intended rather than observed behavior remains a fundamental challenge ( Barr et al., 2014 ; Molina et al., 2025 ) . Classic generators such as EvoSuite ( Fraser and Arcuri, 2011 ) and Randoop use regression oracles that assert the current behavior and thus assume the code is correct ( Dinella et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 测试的有效性取决于其判定的正确性。 尽管生成可执行的测试输入已变得越来越实用，但生成能够捕捉预期行为而非观察行为的断言仍然是一个根本性的挑战（Barr 等，2014；Molina 等，2025）。 像 EvoSuite（Fraser 和 Arcuri，2011）以及 Randoop 这样的经典生成器使用回归判定来断言当前行为，因此假设代码是正确的（Dinella 等，2022）。

paragraphs.en: Recent work revisits the problem for LLMs. Konstantinou et al. ( Konstantinou et al., 2024 ) empirically show that LLM-generated test oracles are prone to capture actual program behavior rather than intended behavior, although the generated tests reach higher fault-detection potential than EvoSuite on the studied benchmarks. A follow-up study ( Konstantinou et al., 2026 ) further shows that tests generated from faulty code inherit its faults, lowering fault detection from 25% to about 14% on function-level benchmarks. Molinelli et al. ( Molinelli et al., 2025 ) conduct a large-scale empirical study showing that LLMs struggle to produce useful oracles for complex specifications despite syntactic correctness. Bodicoat et al. ( Bodicoat et al., 2025 ) provide an empirical study of oracle generation under diverse program characteristics. TOGLL ( Hossain and Dwyer, 2025 ) explores strategies for generating stronger and more correct test oracles from LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究重新审视了大型语言模型（LLM）中的这一问题。Konstantinou等人 （Konstantinou等人，2024）通过实证研究表明，由LLM生成的测试预言子更容易捕捉程序的实际行为而非预期行为，尽管在研究的基准测试中，这些生成的测试比EvoSuite具有更高的故障检测潜力。 一项后续研究（Konstantinou等人，2026）进一步表明，从有缺陷的代码中生成的测试会继承其故障，导致在函数级基准测试中的故障检测率从25%降至约14%。Molinelli等人 （Molinelli等人，2025）进行了一项大规模实证研究，结果表明，尽管语法正确，LLM在生成复杂规格的有用预言子方面仍存在困难。Bodicoat等人 （Bodicoat等人，2025）对在不同程序特性下生成预言子的过程进行了实证研究。 TOGLL（Hossain和Dwyer，2025）探索了从LLM中生成更强、更准确的测试预言子的策略。

paragraphs.en: These studies evaluate oracles at a single point in time, mostly on function-level benchmarks, whereas the generation systems above are typically judged by whether tests pass and cover the changed code. A test that encodes incorrect expectations passes on, and covers, the faulty code, so such evaluation rewards it. To our knowledge, none of these studies follows such tests through a project’s history. Our empirical study captures this failure mode, enabling its systematic measurement and longitudinal evaluation.

paragraphs.en: We investigate how LLM-generated regression tests behave as a project evolves with three research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们围绕以下三个研究问题，探究了大型语言模型（LLM）生成的回归测试在项目演进过程中的表现：

paragraphs.en: How often do LLM-generated regression tests enforce faults?
paragraphs.zh: LLM生成的回归测试有多频繁地强制执行故障？

paragraphs.en: How often do fault-enforcing tests persist across later pull requests?
paragraphs.zh: 故障强制执行测试在后续拉取请求中持续出现的频率有多高？

paragraphs.en: When faults accumulate in one codebase, how many remain enforced by generated tests, and does the project’s test suite detect them?
paragraphs.zh: 当一个代码库中累积了多个故障时，有多少故障仍能被生成的测试所验证，以及项目的测试套件能否检测出这些故障？

paragraphs.en: Stage 1: Commit-Level Mutation. For each pull request, we apply standard mutation operators to the functions that the PR modifies and, when a method of a class changes, to the other methods of that class. This scopes mutation to the neighborhood of the change, following the commit-aware paradigm ( Ma et al., 2021 ; Ma et al., 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1：提交层突变。 对于每个拉取请求，我们对该请求所修改的函数应用标准的突变算子；当某个类的某个方法发生变化时，我们还会对该类中的其他方法应用突变算子。 这种做法将突变范围限定在变更的邻近区域，遵循了“提交感知”范式（Ma et al., 2021; Ma et al., 2020）。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2: Test Survival. We assume that a faulty PR whose fault is detected by the existing test suite would not be merged and would trigger no further testing effort. We therefore run the project’s test suite after applying the PR on every mutant, considering only tests that pass on C new C_{\text{new}} . A failure of a test that already fails on C new C_{\text{new}} says nothing about the mutant. If some considered test fails on a mutant, the suite detects the fault and we discard the mutant. Only surviving mutants continue to the next stage; they represent faulty PRs that pass the project’s tests and are merged, which is where additional regression tests can make a difference.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 2：生存测试。 我们假设，一个存在缺陷且其缺陷已被现有测试套件检测到的 PR 不会被合并，也不会触发任何进一步的测试工作。 因此，在将 PR 应用于每个变异体后，我们会运行项目的测试套件，并仅考虑在 C_new（C_{\text{new}}）上通过的测试。 一个在 C_new（C_{\text{new}}）上已经失败的测试的失败，无法说明任何关于该变异体的信息。 如果某个被考虑的测试在变异体上失败，则测试套件会检测到该缺陷，我们将丢弃该变异体。 只有“存活”的变异体会进入下一阶段；它们代表那些通过项目测试并被合并的有缺陷的 PR，而正是在这一阶段，额外的回归测试才能发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: Stage 3: Killability. A surviving mutant may be equivalent to C new C_{\text{new}} , i.e., behave identically on all inputs, or differ only in ways that no reasonable test can observe. Such a mutant is not a fault, and every test for it ends up weak or invalid, which would distort our results. Since equivalence is undecidable in general, we approximate it empirically. For each surviving mutant, an LLM receives the original and the mutated function and writes a detection test . A mutant is empirically killable if, within k k attempts, at least one such test passes on C new C_{\text{new}} and fails on the mutant. We keep only killable mutants, so that each C fault C_{\text{fault}} contains a fault that the existing suite misses and that some test can detect.

sents.en: A surviving mutant may be equivalent to C new C_{\text{new}} , i.e., behave identically on all inputs, or differ only in ways that no reasonable test can observe.

sents.zh: 由于等价性在一般情况下是不可判定的，我们通过经验方法对其进行近似处理。

paragraphs.en: Baseline gating. Between pull requests, the surrounding codebase drifts: imports move, dependencies change, and a test can fail for reasons unrelated to any mutation. Every claim we are making at a pull request level is therefore gated based on a clean baseline: the generated test is first run on the original codebase after the reference pull request is merged. A run that ends in a collection error or a timeout is skipped. We also pre-filter developer tests: Before being considered to kill a propagated fault, it must first pass on the original codebase.
paragraphs.zh: 基线门控。 在拉取请求之间，周围的代码库会发生漂移：导入项会变动，依赖关系会改变，而某个测试可能因与任何突变无关的原因而失败。 因此，我们在拉取请求层面提出的每一项主张都基于干净的基线进行门控：在合并参考拉取请求后，首先生成的测试会在原始代码库上运行。 以集合错误或超时结束的运行将被跳过。 我们还会预先筛选开发者测试：在被考虑用于终止传播的故障之前，该测试必须首先在原始代码库上通过。

paragraphs.en: Persistence follows one fault at a time, but faults can also accumulate: a project that merges fault-enforcing tests at successive changes may end up with several latent faults at once. We simulate such histories. Starting from a pull request P ​ R i PR_{i} , we step through the later PRs and at each P ​ R k PR_{k} add the fault of one randomly chosen fault-enforcing test generated for P ​ R k PR_{k} (at most one per source file), together with that test. At every P ​ R k PR_{k} , all faults added so far are injected into the code at once, and each test runs against its own fault in the presence of the others. At the end of the history we measure how many tests still enforce their fault and whether the project’s test suite detects the accumulated faults. We repeat the simulation N times per source PR with different random choices and report averages.
paragraphs.zh: 持续性每次只遵循一个故障，但故障也可能累积：如果一个项目在连续变更中合并了强制检测故障的测试，最终可能会同时存在多个潜伏故障。 我们对这类历史进行模拟。 从拉取请求 P ​ R i PR_{i} 开始，我们依次处理后续 PR，在每个 P ​ R k PR_{k} 时，添加一个为该 P ​ R k PR_{k} 生成的随机选择的强制检测故障测试（每个源文件最多一个），以及该测试本身。 在每个 P ​ R k PR_{k} 时，所有已添加的故障都会一次性注入代码，并且每个测试都会在存在其他故障的情况下针对自身的故障运行。 在历史结束时，我们会测量还有多少测试能继续检测其故障，以及项目的测试套件是否检测到了累积的故障。 我们对每个源 PR 重复模拟 N 次，每次使用不同的随机选择，并报告平均值。

sents.zh: 从拉取请求 P ​ R i PR_{i} 开始，我们依次处理后续 PR，在每个 P ​ R k PR_{k} 时，添加一个为该 P ​ R k PR_{k} 生成的随机选择的强制检测故障测试（每个源文件最多一个），以及该测试本身。

sents.en: At every P ​ R k PR_{k} , all faults added so far are injected into the code at once, and each test runs against its own fault in the presence of the others.
sents.zh: 在每个 P ​ R k PR_{k} 时，所有已添加的故障都会一次性注入代码，并且每个测试都会在存在其他故障的情况下针对自身的故障运行。

sents.en: At the end of the history we measure how many tests still enforce their fault and whether the project’s test suite detects the accumulated faults.
sents.zh: 在历史结束时，我们会测量还有多少测试能继续检测其故障，以及项目的测试套件是否检测到了累积的故障。

sents.en: We repeat the simulation N times per source PR with different random choices and report averages.
sents.zh: 我们对每个源 PR 重复模拟 N 次，每次使用不同的随机选择，并报告平均值。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on SciPy ( Virtanen et al., 2020 ) , a mature scientific-computing library with an extensive regression suite across numerical domains; Qiskit ( Javadi-Abhari et al., 2024 ) , IBM’s quantum-computing framework, with a substantially different code and test structure; and pandas ( McKinney, 2010 ) , a widely used data-analysis library. We study pull requests that are merged throughout the project’s history and generate regression tests for lines uncovered by the existing test suite. We only consider merged pull requests that change code beyond deletions and documentation, and exclude backports, documentation-titled changes, changes outside the instrumented source tree (for pandas, its I/O module), and changes to more than five code files, which are mostly refactorings. To evaluate the impact of LLM-based regression tests, we focus on patches which change is not fully covered. This selection results in 121 SciPy, 135 Qiskit and 45 pandas pull requests. For our evaluation, we use all 45 pandas pull requests and randomly sample 50 pull requests from SciPy and Qiskit. This results in 145 pull requests in total that we mutate to introduce potential faults in the implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SciPy（Virtanen 等人，2020）上进行评估，这是一个成熟的科学计算库，拥有覆盖多个数值领域的广泛回归测试套件；Qiskit（Javadi-Abhari 等人，2024），IBM 的量子计算框架，其代码和测试结构与前者截然不同；以及 pandas（McKinney，2010），一个广泛使用的数据分析库。 我们研究项目历史中被合并的拉取请求，并为现有测试套件未覆盖的代码行生成回归测试。 我们仅考虑那些修改了代码（除删除和文档更新外）的已合并拉取请求，并排除向后移植、标题为“文档”的变更、工具化源代码树之外的变更（对于 pandas，即其 I/O 模块），以及修改超过五个代码文件的变更，这些变更大多是重构。 为了评估基于 LLM 的回归测试的影响，我们重点关注那些修改未被完全覆盖的补丁。 这一筛选过程得到了 121 个 SciPy、135 个 Qiskit 和 45 个 pandas 的拉取请求。 在评估中，我们使用了全部 45 个 pandas 的拉取请求，并从 SciPy 和 Qiskit 中随机抽取了 50 个拉取请求。 最终，我们共获得了 145 个拉取请求，并对这些请求进行了变异，以在实现中引入潜在的故障。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 summarizes the mutation analysis across all three projects. Out of 60,780 mutants, 56,165 mutants can be executed by the project’s test suite without running into collection errors or timeouts. SciPy’s and Qiskit’s suites kill a majority of mutants in changed code (58.6% and 54.0%); pandas’ kills 16.0%. Of the survivors, 41–72% are empirically killable; the rest are equivalent or hard to kill within the attempt budget. The budget is enough to identify most empirically killable mutants: we find that the eighth turn adds only 1.3%, 4.3% and 2.1% of the killable mutants, indicating the effectiveness of the LLM converges.

paragraphs.en: A substantial fraction are fault-enforcing. As expected, we find that a substantial fraction of LLM-generated regression tests enforce the fault. 16.9%, 8.4% and 16.9% (587, 281 and 1,614) fail on the original yet pass on the mutant. The per-project shares are imprecise, SciPy’s most (95% interval 8.4–26.2%), but the direction is not. In every project, the lower bound of the fault-enforcing interval lies above the upper bound of the fault-revealing one, with point ratios of 3.5–6.5 × \times .

paragraphs.en: Very few generated tests are fault-revealing. Surprisingly, even though automated regression testing is not designed for this purpose, we find that the LLM-generated regression tests are capable to reveal faults. In total, 2.6%, 2.4% and 4.8% of pairs (90 of 3,483, 81 of 3,355 and 455 of 9,578) pass on the original implementation and fail on the mutant. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 takes a worst-case view: in 92 of the 145 pull requests (63%; 33 of 50 in SciPy, 30 of 50 in Qiskit and 29 of 45 in pandas), at least one injected fault led to a fault-enforcing test. paragraphs.en: We categorized the assertions that enforce the fault. Exception expectations dominate with 37–57% of enforcing tests expect an exception (e.g., pytest.raises ), against 3–9% of fault-revealing tests, which mostly check exact values, types or shapes. Figure 7 shows an example from SciPy #20284.

paragraphs.en: To answer RQ2, we follow each fault-enforcing test through the later pull requests of its project (Section 3.4 ). We assume that (1) a developer who does not detect the faulty PR merges the passing, fault-enforcing tests together with it, (2) when the mutated code is rewritten, the fault is no longer present and the pair leaves the analysis without a verdict, and (3) a developer test that fails on the mutant and passes on the original code would expose the fault. We do not stop tracking a pair when such a test exists, but report these cases separately. Table 4 shows the results.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答研究问题2，我们追踪每个故障触发测试在其项目后续拉取请求中的执行过程（第3.4节）。 我们假设：（1）未能检测到有缺陷拉取请求的开发者会将其中的通过型故障触发测试一并合并；（2）当突变代码被重写后，故障将不复存在，该测试对也不会得出任何判定结果；（3）在突变代码上失败但在原始代码上通过的测试能够暴露该故障。 即使存在此类测试，我们也不会停止对该测试对的追踪，而是将这些情况单独报告。 表4展示了相关结果。

paragraphs.en: In every project, most fault-enforcing tests survive until the last pull request: 85.5% in SciPy, 82.8% in Qiskit, and 90.9% in pandas. Almost all of the remaining pairs are excluded because the mutated code was rewritten (8.7%–17.2%); among pairs whose mutation still applies, 99.5%–100% survive. Killed and weakened pairs are negligible (at most 0.4%). Surviving does not mean the fault stays unnoticed, however: a developer test fails on the fault at some later PR for 36.3% of SciPy pairs, but for only 6.1% and 7.6% in Qiskit and pandas, and the generated test keeps accepting the fault in the meantime.

paragraphs.en: This suggests a concrete risk of LLM-generated regression tests: a fault-enforcing test persists alongside its fault and may give a false sense of assurance that the faulty behavior is intended. The fault then becomes harder to recognize as a fault, and harder to fix once it is found, because the persisting test fails on the corrected code. In Qiskit and pandas, where developer tests fail on the fault for at most 7.6% of the pairs, the project’s own tests rarely contradict the generated test.
paragraphs.zh: 这表明由大型语言模型生成的回归测试存在一个具体风险：强制验证错误的测试会与其错误一同持续存在，并可能错误地让人误以为这种有缺陷的行为是有意为之。 这样一来，该错误就更难被识别为错误，即使发现后也更难以修复，因为持续存在的测试在修正后的代码上会失败。 在 Qiskit 和 pandas 中，开发者测试因该错误而失败的测试对最多仅占测试对数的 7.6%，因此项目自身的测试很少与生成的测试产生矛盾。

A pair from an early pull request is followed through up to 49 later pull requests, a pair from a late one through only a few, and a pair leaves the study early when its mutated code is rewritten. paragraphs.en: The seven pandas kills share one mechanism, and it is not a test learning the intended behavior. In each, the enforcing tests are dead at the killing pull request, and the detection comes from a sibling function that was green on both sides at the source. Five pairs from #59114 that replace a dependency name with an empty string are caught at #59254, where the rewritten get_dependency_info imports each entry and raises on the empty name; one from #59141 is caught there when __finalize__ reaches an attribute the new code no longer sets; and one from #58370, a bad axis argument, is caught at #58791 once the surrounding code validates it. These crashes, exposed by incidental coverage, are the only detections in 53,288 evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 这七只熊猫的 kill 操作共享一个机制，而且它并非通过测试来学习预期行为。 在每个案例中，执行测试在 kill pull request 阶段就已失败，而检测则来自一个在源代码中两侧均为绿色的兄弟函数。 来自 #59114 的五对将依赖名称替换为空字符串的代码在 #59254 中被捕获，其中重写后的 get_dependency_info 会导入每个条目并在遇到空名称时抛出异常；来自 #59141 的一个案例在 __finalize__ 访问到新代码不再设置的属性时于此处被捕获；而来自 #58370 的一个因轴参数错误导致的案例，则在周围代码完成验证后于 #58791 中被捕获。 这些由偶然覆盖暴露的崩溃是 53,288 次评估中唯一被检测到的问题。

paragraphs.en: We also check whether the project’s own tests detect the propagated fault. A fault counts as caught if a developer test that exercises the mutated function, and that passes on the unmutated code, fails on the mutant at some later pull request. This holds for 36.3% of the SciPy pairs, but for only 6.1% of the Qiskit and 7.6% of the pandas pairs. In these two projects, over 90% of the faults that the generated tests accept are never caught by a developer test within the studied history. This check does not involve the generated tests, so a catch means that the project’s tests would have exposed the fault even without them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还检查项目自身的测试能否检测到传播的故障。 如果某个开发者测试在后续拉取请求中，对变异函数进行了执行、通过了未变异的代码，但在变异体上失败，则该故障被视为被捕获。 在 SciPy 的成对测试中，这一情况适用于 36.3% 的案例；而在 Qiskit 和 pandas 的成对测试中，这一比例分别为 6.1% 和 7.6%。 在这两个项目中，超过 90% 的被生成测试接受的故障，在研究的历史记录中从未被任何开发者测试捕获。 这项检查不涉及生成的测试，因此“捕获”意味着即使没有这些测试，项目的原有测试也能暴露该故障。

paragraphs.en: In RQ1 and RQ2, we considered one fault at a time: whether a generated test enforces it, and whether the test keeps enforcing it across later pull requests. A project may also merge several faulty PRs over time, so faults can accumulate in the same codebase. To answer RQ3, we simulate such histories (Section 3.4 ). Starting from a source pull request, we add at each later pull request one randomly chosen fault together with its fault-enforcing test to the codebase, and run each test against its own fault in the presence of all the others. Every source pull request with a validated pair seeds up to three trials from a seeded random generator; in total, 246 trials from 91 source pull requests complete. Our experiments for RQ3 are a deliberately adverse stress test and not a model of how real faults accumulate. Table 6 summarizes the results.
paragraphs.zh: 在研究问题 1（RQ1）和研究问题 2（RQ2）中，我们每次只考虑一个故障：即生成的测试能否强制触发该故障，以及该测试在后续拉取请求中是否持续有效。 一个项目也可能随着时间的推移合并多个存在故障的拉取请求，因此故障可能会在同一个代码库中累积。 为了解答研究问题 3（RQ3），我们对这类历史过程进行了模拟（第 3.4 节）。 从一个源拉取请求开始，我们在每个后续拉取请求中向代码库添加一个随机选定的故障及其对应的故障触发测试，并在所有其他故障存在的情况下，针对该故障运行其专属的测试。 每个经过验证的源拉取请求会基于一个预置随机生成器启动最多三次试验；最终共有来自 91 个源拉取请求的 246 次试验完成。 我们对研究问题 3（RQ3）进行的实验是一种刻意设计的严苛压力测试，而非真实故障累积方式的模型。 表 6 总结了这些结果。

The lower line counts the eligible members, those whose test still fails on the unmutated code and still accepts its own fault alone, the only ones for which a pool-induced kill is meaningful.

paragraphs.en: We also run the project’s own tests, those that exercise a mutated function and pass on the unmutated code, against the full pool of injected faults. A member counts as caught only if a test that fails with the pool also fails with that member’s fault alone, so that a catch cannot be due to another fault. By this criterion, the project’s tests catch 30.3% of the SciPy, 13.8% of the Qiskit, and 21.0% of the pandas members. A further 374, 242, and 199 members (27.0%, 20.0%, and 20.0%) fail a test only when the whole pool is present; these catches cannot be attributed to a member, so we do not count them. Percentages are over pool members across all trials, so a pair that appears in several trials is counted each time. paragraphs.en: A fault-enforcing test specifies the behavior of the faulty code. Two factors produce it. The first is the oracle problem: a model that sees only the faulty implementation may take its behavior as the intended one and write an assertion accordingly. The second is the acceptance criterion commonly applied in LLM-based regression testing (Section 3.3 ): a test is accepted only if it passes on the code the generator sees. An accepted test needs to pass on C fault C_{\text{fault}} and hence can only be weak or fault-enforcing, while a test that would reveal the fault is discarded or revised. We find that tests that would have been discarded when the refinement budget runs out can be fault-revealing. This design decision partly contributes to a large gap between 8%–17% fault-enforcing and 2.4%–4.8% fault-revealing tests.
paragraphs.zh: 故障强制测试规定了有缺陷代码的行为。它由两个因素产生。 第一个是“预言机问题”：一个仅能看到有缺陷实现的模型，可能会将其行为视为预期行为，并据此编写断言。 第二个是在基于大语言模型的回归测试中常用的接受标准（第 3.3 节）：只有当测试在生成器所见的代码上通过时，该测试才会被接受。 一个被接受的测试需要在 C 故障 C_{\text{fault}} 上通过，因此只能是弱测试或故障强制测试，而能够揭示故障的测试则会被丢弃或修改。 我们发现，当精炼预算用尽时本应被丢弃的测试，可能反而能够揭示故障。 这一设计决策部分导致了故障强制测试（8%–17%）与故障揭示测试（2.4%–4.8%）之间较大的差距。

paragraphs.en: Regression Testing in general. Fault enforcement is a common problem of automated regression testing, and not specific to LLMs. Any oracle derived from observed behavior, whether written by an LLM or produced by a search-based generator such as Pynguin or EvoSuite, tends to encode what it observes. We additionally find that change-aware LLM generation, which also sees the diff and its context, does not avoid the problem, and that its consequences extend over time (RQ2 and RQ3).

paragraphs.en: One might hope that in an ordinary project fault-enforcing tests are corrected through time: as developers extend the test suite and refactor code, incorrect assumptions would be eventually discovered or over-written. Our results however indicate that this is not the case for a large part of faults (and fault-enforcing tests): We find that 83%–91% of faults can still be applied and are accepted by the generated test. For 64%–94% of all faults no test of the project has failed on the fault by the end of the studied history.

paragraphs.en: For tool builders. Since a fault-enforcing test can only be recognized relative to a corrected version, intervention has to act on where the expectation comes from. Regression testers could derive expectations from specifications, documentation, or the PR description when these exist, following work on oracle generation from natural language ( Hossain and Dwyer, 2025 ) . Our study also indicates a potential of LLM-based (regression) testing: 2.4% – 4.8% of tests are fault-revealing, even after several rounds of refinements. Therefore, tool builders could treat a failing test as a possible fault in the code, as developers do ( Luo et al., 2014 ; Vahabzadeh et al., 2015 ) , and report it instead of repairing or discarding it.
paragraphs.zh: 面向工具构建者。 由于故障强制测试只能相对于修正后的版本才能被识别，因此干预必须针对期望的来源进行。 回归测试人员可以从规范、文档或 PR 描述中（如果存在）推导出期望，这基于从自然语言生成判据的研究（Hossain and Dwyer, 2025）。 我们的研究还表明基于 LLM 的（回归）测试具有潜力：即使经过多轮优化，仍有 2.4%–4.8% 的测试能够揭示故障。 因此，工具构建者可以将失败的测试视为代码中可能存在的故障，就像开发者所做的那样（Luo et al., 2014; Vahabzadeh et al., 2015），并报告该问题，而不是修复或丢弃它。

paragraphs.en: For evaluation. Coverage-guidance is a weak criterion: 41%–70% of the generated tests are weak, which means they cover the changed code but cannot tell apart the faulty version from the reference. Furthermore, evaluation at a single point in time cannot evaluate the impact of tests throughout the project evolution. We hence suggest to employ longitudinal benchmarks that track generated tests across pull request histories to give more realistic estimates of practical value.
paragraphs.zh: 用于评估。 覆盖度引导是一个较弱的标准：生成的测试中约有 41%–70% 属于较弱类型，这意味着它们虽然覆盖了修改后的代码，却无法区分错误版本与参考版本。 此外，在单一时间点进行的评估无法衡量测试在整个项目演化过程中的影响。 因此，我们建议采用纵向基准测试，通过追踪拉取请求历史记录中的生成测试，从而更真实地估计其实际价值。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate with artificial faults (mutants), so our results may not transfer to real faults. Manual analysis of fault-revealing tests showed that many relate to obvious, unrealistic mutations. Simple mutants are easier to detect, and our killability filter keeps only faults that a model can detect, so the fault-revealing rate is likely optimistic.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用人工故障（变异体）进行评估，因此我们的结果可能无法迁移到真实故障。 对故障揭示测试的手动分析表明，许多测试与明显且不切实际的变异有关。 简单的变异体更容易被检测出来，而我们的可终止性过滤器仅保留模型能够检测到的故障，因此故障揭示率很可能过于乐观。

paragraphs.en: We further restrict ourselves to pull requests from three popular open source Python project. Although our results might not generalize to other unseen projects, we find that these projects span three major application domains in numerical computing, quantum computing and data manipulation, with our finding being consistent across all three domains. The projects are in addition all mature, widely used libraries with established regression suites, although their strength varies (the existing suites kill 58.6%, 54.0% and 16.0% of testable mutants in changed code); projects with weaker testing cultures may differ.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步将研究范围限定在三个热门的开源 Python 项目所提交的拉取请求上。 尽管我们的结果可能无法推广到其他未见过的项目，但我们发现这些项目涵盖了数值计算、量子计算和数据处理三大主要应用领域，且我们的研究结论在这三个领域均保持一致。 此外，这些项目都是成熟且广泛使用的库，并配有成熟的回归测试套件，尽管其测试强度各不相同（现有测试套件能够消除已修改代码中 58.6%、54.0% 和 16.0% 的可测试变异体）；测试文化较薄弱的项目可能会有所不同。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate LLM-based regression testing with Claude Haiku 4.5, a model frequently used in practice and research for code and test generation. Our results might however not generalize to stronger models (that might have stronger capabilities to detect faults). However, we believe that our results are a fundamental consequence of the design of LLM-generated regression testing and the stronger capabilities of larger models to follow instructions might amplify our results. We leave this evaluation open for future research.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 来评估基于大型语言模型的回归测试，该模型在代码和测试生成方面被广泛用于实践和研究。 然而，我们的结果可能无法推广到更强大的模型（这些模型可能具备更强的故障检测能力）。 不过，我们相信，我们的结果是大型语言模型所生成回归测试设计的必然体现，而更大模型在执行指令方面的更强能力可能会放大我们的研究结果。 我们将这项评估留待未来研究进一步探索。

paragraphs.en: Our taxonomy depends on correct mutation generation, execution, propagation and container management. All experiments ran in isolated per-pull request containers, categories are deterministic outcomes with no manual overriding, infrastructure errors are never read as results, and unit tests exercise every rule. Killability is relative to the model, so a mutant labeled as not killable within the budget may be equivalent or just beyond Claude Haiku 4.5. Drift is handled by the baseline gate and the per-test reading; a skipped evaluation (5.7% at the gate for SciPy) cannot become a kill but lowers SciPy’s effective sample. Forward propagation can misplace a mutant (Section 4.4 ); a misplaced mutant is far more likely to be skipped or killed than to incorrectly survive, so misplacement works against our continued survival finding. Restricting the longitudinal analyses to evaluations propagated without ambiguity leaves the survived share (85.4%, 82.8%, 90.4%) and the interaction rates (0%, 0.38%, 0.03%) nearly unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的分类体系依赖于正确的突变生成、执行、传播和容器管理。 所有实验均在每个拉取请求的独立容器中运行，分类是确定性的结果且无法手动覆盖，基础设施错误绝不会被读取为结果，而单元测试则覆盖了每一条规则。 可终止性因模型而异，因此一个在预算范围内被标记为不可终止的突变体，可能与 Claude Haiku 4.5 的表现相当，或者仅略高于其能力范围。 漂移由基线门控和每次测试的读取机制处理；一次被跳过的评估（SciPy 在门控阶段的跳过率为 5.7%）不会导致终止，但会降低 SciPy 的有效样本量。 前向传播可能导致突变体被错误定位（第 4.4 节）；一个错误定位的突变体更有可能被跳过或终止，而非错误地存活下来，因此错误定位会削弱我们持续发现存活结果的能力。 将纵向分析限制在传播过程无歧义的评估上后，存活比例（85.4%、82.8%、90.4%）和交互率（0%、0.38%、0.03%）几乎未发生变化。

paragraphs.en: Our framework assumes that mutation testing provides an appropriate proxy for measuring behavioral quality. Although mutants are a valid substitute for real faults in many settings ( Just et al., 2014 ) and commit-relevant mutants relate to real faults ( Ma et al., 2021 ) , generated mutants do not perfectly represent all real programming defects. Standard mutation operators may overrepresent simple arithmetic or logical bugs and underrepresent algorithmic or data-structure defects common in numerical code. What we observe is that a test fails on the original post-commit implementation and passes on a mutant. So, that the test would enforce a real defect is an interpretation, which holds to the extent that the mutant resembles one.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的框架假设突变测试是衡量行为质量的合适代理。 尽管在许多情况下，突变体是真实故障的有效替代（Just 等，2014），且与提交相关的突变体也与真实故障有关（Ma 等，2021），但生成的突变体并不能完美代表所有真实的编程缺陷。 标准的突变算子可能会过度代表简单的算术或逻辑错误，而低估数值代码中常见的算法或数据结构缺陷。 我们观察到的是，某个测试在提交后的原始实现上失败，但在突变体上却通过了。 因此，该测试能够强制检测出真实缺陷这一结论只是一种解释，其成立程度取决于该突变体与真实缺陷的相似性。

paragraphs.en: The coverage test is generated from a diff between the pre -commit source and the mutant, which spans both the pull request’s change and the mutation. This alone cannot cause fault-enforcing behavior because the post-commit code and the mutant differ only by the mutation, so the mutation causes the outcome to change. However, the combined diff could make the model expect pre-commit behavior that the mutation happens to restore. We tested this by running every fault-enforcing test on the pre-commit code and found it in only 0.2% of comparable pairs (Section 5.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖性测试是根据预提交源代码与变异体之间的差异生成的，该差异同时涵盖了拉取请求中的变更和变异。 仅凭这一点无法引发故障强制行为，因为提交后代码与变异体之间唯一的差异就是变异本身，因此该变异会导致结果发生变化。 然而，合并后的差异可能会使模型预期在预提交阶段出现某种行为，而该变异恰好恢复了这种行为。 我们通过将每个故障强制测试运行在预提交代码上进行了验证，发现这种情况仅出现在可比较配对中的 0.2%（第 5.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: Classification is by execution outcome, not assertion intent, so some weak tests may still document behavior. The one-mutant-per-file rule caps pool density, so RQ3’s kill rate is a lower bound on denser accumulation, and it measures the stability of an incorrect expectation, not classical masking.
paragraphs.zh: 分类依据是执行结果，而非断言意图，因此某些较弱的测试可能仍然能够记录行为。 每文件一个变异体的规则限制了池的密度，因此 RQ3 的击杀率是更高密度情况下密度的一个下界，并且它衡量的是错误预期的稳定性，而非经典的掩码机制。

paragraphs.en: Pull requests vary widely (Section 5.1.2 ), so we report intervals from bootstraps that resample whole pull requests and per-pull-request sign and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Every headline comparison holds at that level. Per-project point estimates are imprecise (SciPy’s fault-enforcing share spans 8.4–26.2%), so we claim directions and ranges rather than exact per-project rates. Pull requests with no propagated fault-enforcing pair (17 of 50 SciPy, 21 of 50 Qiskit and 16 of 45 pandas) are by construction absent from the longitudinal analyses, and all 91 eligible source pull requests have completed both analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 拉取请求的差异极大（第 5.1.2 节），因此我们报告了通过重采样整个拉取请求以及针对每个拉取请求的符号和威尔科克森符号秩检验所获得的自助法置信区间。 所有标题比较在该层级上均成立。 每个项目的点估计值不够精确（SciPy 中强制要求故障处理的占比范围在 8.4%–26.2% 之间），因此我们仅说明趋势和范围，而非每个项目的精确比率。 那些没有传播的故障处理配对的拉取请求（50 个 SciPy 中有 17 个，50 个 Qiskit 中有 21 个，以及 45 个 pandas 中有 16 个）根据定义被排除在纵向分析之外，而所有 91 个符合条件的源拉取请求均已完成两项分析。

paragraphs.en: We presented an empirical study of whether LLM-generated regression tests enforce the behavior of (potentially faulty) PRs. To this end, we injected real-world PRs with artificial faults, generated regression tests for the faulty PRs, and then classified the test outcomes with a four-category taxonomy: fault-revealing, fault-enforcing, weak, and invalid. Our evaluation focused a coverage-guided, change-aware LLM-based approach that accepts only tests passing on the code it sees, and we evaluate on 145 pull requests from SciPy, Qiskit, and pandas. We find that 8%–17% of the generated tests are fault-enforcing and only 2.4%–4.8% are fault-revealing. Following 2,480 fault-enforcing pairs through later pull requests, 83%–91% still accept their fault at the end of the studied history, also where later changes touched the mutated function, and almost none comes to detect it. The project’s test suite catches the fault for 6%–8% of the pairs in Qiskit and pandas and for 36% in SciPy. In a deliberately adverse stress test with pools of up to 24 simultaneous faults, a test stopped accepting its fault in at most 0.4% of evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开展了一项实证研究，旨在探究由大型语言模型（LLM）生成的回归测试是否能够确保（可能存在缺陷的）拉取请求（PR）的行为。 为此，我们在真实世界的拉取请求中人为注入缺陷，为这些存在缺陷的拉取请求生成回归测试，然后使用一个包含四个类别的分类体系对测试结果进行分类：揭示缺陷、维持缺陷、弱测试和无效测试。 我们的评估聚焦于一种以覆盖率为指导、感知代码变更的基于大型语言模型的方法，该方法仅接受在其所见代码上通过的测试，并在 SciPy、Qiskit 和 pandas 中的 145 个拉取请求上进行评估。 我们发现，生成的测试中 8%–17% 属于维持缺陷类型，而揭示缺陷的测试仅占 2.4%–4.8%。 通过后续拉取请求追踪 2,480 对维持缺陷的测试后，在研究的历史记录结束时，仍有 83%–91% 的测试继续接受其缺陷，即使后续变更影响了被修改的函数，且几乎没有测试能够检测到该缺陷。 在 Qiskit 和 pandas 中，项目测试套件能捕获 6%–8% 的缺陷对；而在 SciPy 中，这一比例为 36%。 在一项刻意设计的严苛压力测试中，我们同时引入了多达 24 个缺陷，结果显示，在最多不超过 0.4% 的评估中，测试才停止接受其对应的缺陷。

paragraphs.en: This suggests a concrete risk of LLM-generated regression tests. When a faulty PR is accepted and merged, a generated test can become fault-enforcing: it passes silently on the faulty code, giving false confidence, and it fails once the fault is fixed, making the fix harder.
paragraphs.zh: 这表明由大型语言模型生成的回归测试存在具体的风险。 当一个有缺陷的拉取请求被接受并合并时，生成的测试可能会变成故障强化机制：它在有缺陷的代码上静默通过，从而产生虚假的信心；而一旦故障被修复，该测试就会失败，使得修复变得更加困难。

sents.en: When a faulty PR is accepted and merged, a generated test can become fault-enforcing: it passes silently on the faulty code, giving false confidence, and it fails once the fault is fixed, making the fix harder.
sents.zh: 当一个有缺陷的拉取请求被接受并合并时，生成的测试可能会变成故障强化机制：它在有缺陷的代码上静默通过，从而产生虚假的信心；而一旦故障被修复，该测试就会失败，使得修复变得更加困难。

paragraphs.en: Developers should therefore not treat a passing generated test as evidence of correctness: before merging, they should check its expected values against the intended behavior. Future work should derive expectations from specifications or PR descriptions instead of the observed code, and should treat a failing generated test as a possible fault in the code, not only in the test. It should also evaluate generation approaches that do not require tests to pass, to separate the effect of the acceptance criterion from the oracle problem.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，开发者不应将生成的测试通过视为正确性的证据：在合并代码之前，他们应检查其预期值是否符合预期的行为。 未来的工作应从规范或拉取请求描述中推导预期，而不是从观察到的代码中推导，并且应将生成的测试失败视为代码中可能存在的故障，而不仅仅是测试本身的问题。 此外，还应评估那些不要求测试通过的生成方法，以便将接受标准的影响与预言机问题区分开来。
